intent: また行き詰まったら、もう一度来てよいかを聞く
en: Can I come back if I get stuck again?
ja: また行き詰まったら、もう一度来てもいいですか。

flags.note: どの要の部分も 10 件に届かない（MICASE の学生の発話で数えた）ので ①②③ で判定しない。MICASE の学生の発話では首位が 3 件未満（can i come back | could i come back | if i come back | come back later | come back tomorrow | come back next week | stop by again | come by again | come back if 2 件）。Math Stack Exchange の質問で最も多い要の部分 can i come back | could i come back | if i come back | come back later | come back tomorrow | come back next week | stop by again | come by again | come back if（5 件。3 件以上）なので使われている。en の要の部分 can i come back | could i come back | if i come back | come back later | come back tomorrow | come back next week | stop by again | come by again | come back if も 5 件（3 件以上）なので en のまま。register は主張しない。
